summary: Skeena Resources Ltd filed a Form 6-K furnishing its Q1 2026 financial results press release, interim financial statements, and MD&A. The filing is a routine quarterly earnings report from a gold/silver development company advancing the Eskay Creek project in British Columbia towards planned initial production in Q2 2027. No transaction, activist campaign, strategic review, or special situation event is announced. The CEO and CFO remain in place. This is an ordinary current report by a foreign private issuer, not a special-situation filing.
